boss.title: Boss mural!
boss.text: {name}, in its toughest version: no rescue slot this time. Take your time.
rules.intro: Tap a queue to put its box on the line.
rules.ants: The ants head out for pixels of their color that they can reach from the edge. Those with nothing in reach wait in the box.

end.stuckText: No carrier can reach a pixel of its color anymore.
end.seriesOver: The series starts over, a little tighter.
community.title: Community murals
community.text: Drawn by players. Pick one to take apart!
ed.hint: Click to paint, right-click to erase. Shortcuts: B brush, F fill, I picker, E eraser, Ctrl+Z undo.
ed.name: Name
ed.slotsHelp: Fewer slots, more tension. 4 is the usual.
ed.bgHelp: Load a picture to trace over: it stays under the grid and isn't saved with the mural.
ed.bgConverted: Image converted. Touch it up with the brush if needed.
ed.convHelp: After converting, these settings apply live (Ctrl+Z goes back to before the conversion).
ed.copyManual: Can't copy here: the text is selected, press Ctrl+C.
ed.suggestHelp: Opens a GitHub form (free account): if it's picked, it joins the community murals.
ed.suggestOpened: Form opened in a new tab. The code is copied too, just in case.
ed.suggestPaste: This mural is too big to fill in the form by itself: paste the code (already copied) into the “Code” field.
ed.badCode: This code isn't valid. Check that it's complete.
ed.devHelp: Paste into src/data/maps.js, then add the name to each file in locales/.
